SPACE QUADS

Roller Skating Club In Graz

Our Passion

Space Quads was created to share our love of roller skating, empower and support people throughout their individual skate journeys and bring recognition to the rich history and vast potential of roller skating as a sport.

Our Mission

We strive to help grow the roller skating community in Graz by creating safe and supportive spaces for skaters of all ages, backgrounds, and levels to thrive and further develop their passion and love of the sport.

  • "It"s a real safe space, there's lots of laughter, we help each other and look forward to learning something new every week. I learned more in my first course than I did in all the months of watching Youtube videos and I go home after each lesson excited for the next."

    Isabelle A.

  • "I actually never wanted to set foot on a ramp, but I tried it thanks to Brookie & Kat and now I love it. The first skatepark session pulled me out of a depressive phase. At the skatepark you really get to experience your own progress and sense of achievement up close."

    Lena B.

  • "After the beginners course I signed up for the skatepark course - best decision I could have made. I am always surprised how much you can learn in such a short amount of time and how fun it is. Roller skating gives me confidence and is the perfect balance to every day office life."

    Kathrin K.

  • "Standing on roller skates for the first time was an unfamiliar, but amazing feeling for me. I attended the Space Quads course and gradually learned to have control over my feet. Once you have that, skating is really fun. You fall down a lot, but at the same time you feel so free."

    Viola S.

  • "Ever since standing on roller skates for the first time, I have loved it. Brookie and Kat helped me a lot throughout this journey and made their classes fun. It's really cool to learn new tricks, even if you fall down sometimes!"

    Rosa M.

  • "I love roller skating because it's possible to learn any trick, especially when you have Brookie and Kat! It's so fun to try something new and push past your fears and when you accomplish something it's such an amazing feeling. Everyone should experience that sense of achievement - to me roller skating is success!"

    Michaela N.

  • "When I moved to Graz I had the feeling I was finally home and the first thing I bought were roller skates. It's made such a big difference, I've learned so much with these girls! The lessons are great and I haven't felt this amazing in a long time."

    Fanny C.

  • "Best support! From the consultation when buying roller skates to the execution of the course just the best! Friendly, competent and fun! Join Space Quads!"

    Brigitte P.

  • "I never thought after my first training that I would set foot on a ramp at the skatepark or be able to do a 180! Brookie & Kat always believed in us, even when I needed 100 attempts. I am forever grateful to them, they do great work!"

    Lisa D.

DONATE YOUR OLD SKATES

-

DONATE YOUR OLD SKATES -

Old Roller Skates Collecting Dust?

Roller skating can be an expensive hobby, especially when getting started - between buying skates and protective gear it can quickly add up. By donating your old skates to our collection you can help people get started on their skate journeys, make roller skating more accessible, and help grow the community. Join us in spreading the love of skating today!

Contact us to arrange drop-off or pick-up!
